scores.rationale: The candidate stopped after writing a Definition of Done (`.lore/dod.md`), updating two spec files, and adding an acceptance test file (`src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts`). It did not implement any of the production code required by the issue (`src/types/messages.ts`, `src/types/session.ts`, `src/transport/ws/validation.ts`, `src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts`, `src/transport/createServer.ts`, `src/config.ts`, `StoreCannotList`, etc.), nor did it update the documentation or changelog. Because none of the implementation exists, the newly added acceptance tests will immediately fail on missing validation logic, missing server options, and unhandled WebSocket message types. Even in the test expectation, the candidate mistakenly expects the current connection's empty session to be absent from the returned conversation list (`['newest', 'middle', 'oldest']`), violating the explicit requirement in the issue that the active connection's conversation is listed like any other.
